messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Prospect (SirenProof) signed NDA. They want a short perf validation next Thu: smoke + sustained + bursts. Need load plan, quick hosted vs Dedicated cost, and KMS/audit wording for their security team.

devon_se: I can draft runbook. Workload: avg input ~420 tokens, gen ~160. Plan: smoke 10m@20qps, sustained 20m@90qps, 6 microbursts 25s@210qps every 100s. Will provide JMeter + small python harness.

tessops: Ops: Dedicated recommended for predictable p99 during bursts. Hosted ok with pre-warm + 2x burst nodes. Need their IP ranges and SLA preference. KMS/audit are enterprise add-ons (ops needs infra contact).

raj_eng: Provide curl payload and headers for warm/cold so buyer can run themselves? Also enable trace sampling 1% and p50/p95/p99 in rtail during run.

devon_se: Curl well give them:

POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-xl-1.0","input":"Summarize: <SAMPLE>","max_tokens":180}

Use header X-RW-KV-Cache: false for cold, X-RW-Warm: true for warm.

tessops: Quick BEO: hosted gen ~$0.00042/token -> 100k tokens ~= $42 + ~$100 ops. Dedicated small node ~$460/day. KMS/audit setup ~$500 one-time + $200/mo retention.

maria_sales: I'll send schedule and ask for IPs + KMS contact. Thanks team :thumbsup:
